name: Compile detailed lists and reports on diseases
description: Users requested comprehensive lists, categorizations, and detailed reports on various infectious, genetic, and chronic diseases, often focusing on epidemiological trends, pathogenic mechanisms, differential diagnoses, and public health implications. The requests frequently asked for structured enumerations of conditions, their specific risks, and historical or global context rather than brief definitions of single ailments.
